definitions.explanation: An organized group of people with similar political views who seek to influence government policy by getting candidates elected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{政党|せいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are multiple political parties in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{政党|せいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大勝|たいしょう}した→大勝：noentry⟧。
examples.english: That political party won big in the election.

examples.japanese: {政党|せいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}しない→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦{無所属|むしょぞく}→無所属：13583_mushozoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are also independent legislators who don't belong to any party.
examples.notes: 無所属 = independent (not affiliated with a party)

notes:
{政党|せいとう} refers to organized political parties. Japan has a multi-party system with several major and minor parties.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {政党|せいとう}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: party politics
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧: ruling party, party in power
- ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: opposition party
- ⟦{連立|れんりつ}→連立：14492_renritsu⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: coalition government

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: member of parliament
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: election
- ⟦{無所属|むしょぞく}→無所属：13583_mushozoku⟧: independent (no party affiliation)
